note: Specified application/workflow scenarios, not executed by creating the kit. Original V2 scenarios are retained; V01 onward are V3 additions. Actual commands/results are recorded during the authorized build.

A task-specific setting is actually effective; a conflicting role file cannot silently override the intended route.
Each writer proves its cwd/base SHA/allowed paths; no shared-checkout overlap.

Ledger remains correct; no false completion or replayed external mutation.
Four valid frontmatter skills route to existing task docs without loading every specification.

Actual outgoing request omits unsupported sampling/log-probability options; permitted effort verified.
Complete JSON arguments, stable call ID, one harmless execution and linked result produce a continued response.
Errors are visible and bounded; the stored run/SQL candidate are not recreated or replayed.

Gateway/OpenAI/Daytona settings and evidence expose no key, connection string or unintended row value.
Automatic spans/log exporters do not transmit secret-bearing inputs/outputs; disabled/default behavior actually checked.

Actual TrueForge JS client and Python service negotiate successfully despite different package majors.
Business run remains durable; get_run observation is safe; no source SQL retry wrapper.
Selected SDK deployment rejects disallowed host/origin exposure and remains loopback/private; negative test recorded.

Incomplete tool arguments cannot create a candidate, run, write or cleanup operation.
Both fail closed independently; successful TLS is hostname-verified, not encryption-only.
Described clone matches approved private storage/KMS/SG settings; magnetic/unsupported configuration fails clearly.

scenarios.scenario: Lazy loading and clone timing labels
scenarios.required_assertion: Available is not asserted warm; observed storage state/timing labels have no invented percent or production projection.
Unavailable Gateway/AWS/sandbox trace fields stay NOT_OBSERVED; final report identity remains valid.
Instruction-like data cannot change checks, model permissions, targets or approval requirements.
Metadata/error strings are escaped; no script/unsafe HTML/credential-bearing generated link in the native report.

scenarios.scenario: Dependency inventory and public license claims
scenarios.required_assertion: Version/integrity/notices recorded; pglast GPL metadata not mislabeled MIT; no claim of legal clearance.

scenarios.scenario: Final organizer requirements and provider fallback
scenarios.required_assertion: Actual final rules recorded; Gateway used or explicit rules-compatible fallback disclosed; coding-start provenance honest.
Actual final artifacts reviewed for secrets/row values; publication performed only after authorization.

scenarios.scenario: Integrated patch evidence differs from worker evidence
scenarios.required_assertion: Lead reviews allowed paths, merges exact changes and reruns affected integration; worker green alone is not final green.
All 36 primary assignments and normal role defaults use 6 Sol or 5.6 Sol with High; actual runtime role observations agree.
Model unavailability, slow tasks or normal errors do not promote to Astra, Fast, Pro/Ultra, xhigh or max.
Only unused A1/A2 tickets admit one focused Astra session; a critical investigation consumes a slot; a third requires explicit user extension.
Astra returns findings without implementation, delegation, cloud changes or approval clicks; Sol makes and tests repairs.
Unchanged safety boundary skips another Astra rescan; a material diff is reviewed using an available slot and exact commit.
No fabricated allowance numbers, savings percentages, Astra identity or performed review; independent Sol substitution is explicit.
A valid UPDATE to a supported existing column outside preserve_columns and intended-value requirements cannot PASS.

scenarios.scenario: Weak checks do not cover value intent
scenarios.required_assertion: Row count, no_nulls and uniqueness without supported intended-value coverage yield COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE/WARN for unprotected value updates.
An allowed UPDATE changing a protected value remains executable on the clone and deterministic comparison forces BLOCK.
Supported mandatory all_equal plus complete schema/preservation requirements passes only when actual evidence matches.

scenarios.scenario: New-column coverage and real NOT NULL
scenarios.required_assertion: An added column needs expected schema and mandatory value coverage; zero nulls does not substitute for a schema NOT NULL requirement.
Known SQL/required-check failure is BLOCK even with a coverage gap; otherwise missing coverage is WARN, never PASS.
Duplicate/unknown/missing result IDs and a model-edited mandatory flag cannot evade the frozen requirement manifest.
Within each DB capture, schema/count/hash measurements share the controlled read-only transaction; source and clone snapshots remain separate.
Invalid UTF-8, duplicate JSON keys, NaN/infinity, excessive size/depth and unsupported versions are rejected without side effects.
Valid report and separately provided matching digest yield EXPECTED_DIGEST_MATCH while current apply eligibility stays NOT_EVALUATED.
Changed payload with old report hash fails integrity.

scenarios.scenario: Offline forged payload with new self-hash
scenarios.required_assertion: A report modified and rehashed fails against the original independently retained expected digest.
No trusted expected hash yields SELF_CONSISTENT_UNANCHORED, never authenticated or proof of real AWS execution.

scenarios.scenario: Offline historical BLOCK and missing checks
scenarios.required_assertion: A truthful complete BLOCK artifact verifies as historical BLOCK; forged PASS or missing mandatory results fail semantic verification.
Verifier preserves backend labels, rejects unknown schema/backend, and runs with no network, AWS/DB credentials or model client.
T27 acceptance/critical findings closure precedes T24 live write; mocked/local tests do not impersonate human approval.
Batch limits/backoff/deadline bound polls; pending expiry preserves run and emits a checkpoint, not a new clone or replay.
Only observation tools run in polling batches; apply/cleanup remain separately visible literal human gates.

scenarios.scenario: Runtime stays on a tested Sol route
scenarios.required_assertion: 6 Sol/high or tested 5.6 Sol/high; no runtime Astra; compatibility-none route needs explicit operator choice and truthful effort label.
Actual tool/service/receipt evidence grades each behavior case; a model saying it passed cannot mark a case PASS.

scenarios.scenario: Material fixes invalidate stale review assurance
scenarios.required_assertion: Safety-changing fixes after A1 receive targeted independent Sol recheck before any further live apply; A2 is conditional and does not waive findings.
The typed all_equal-to-null check uses explicit null semantics; SQL equality to NULL or vacuous missing-column behavior cannot produce PASS.
